text: Acadomia's legal notice names DOMIA GROUP (RCS Paris 349 367 557) as the site's editor and states that the operating companies AIS 2 SAS – ACADOMIA and ACADOMIA PRO SAS are subsidiaries (filiales) of DOMIA GROUP SA.
short: Acadomia is a subsidiary of Domia Group SA
